subject.title: docs: document embedded compaction context contracts

question: Should maintainers refresh and land this focused embedded-runner comment slice, or close it in favor of an overlapping documentation PR?
rationale: The PR is useful and proof-positive, but the protected maintainer label, dirty merge state, and overlapping comment PRs require an explicit maintainer landing order rather than an automated cleanup close.

options.title: Refresh This Focused Slice
options.body: Recreate the focused comment-only changes on current main, run a whitespace check, and then land it as the preferred source for the overlapping fallback-boundary comments.

options.title: Use An Overlapping PR Instead
options.body: Close this branch only if maintainers decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89533 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89585 should be the canonical landing path.

options.title: Pause Until Runner Churn Settles
options.body: Leave this open without landing until the embedded-runner churn slows enough that comments can be reviewed once against stable current code.

recommendation.title: Refresh This Focused Slice
recommendation.body: Recreate the focused comment-only changes on current main, run a whitespace check, and then land it as the preferred source for the overlapping fallback-boundary comments.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on these embedded-runner contracts and wrote the latest comment recommending how to refresh this PR relative to the overlapping branch.
